title: Four names for a Shanghai morning
summary: Dabing, youtiao, cifantuan and doujiang are grouped in Shanghai’s municipal food guide as four classic breakfast staples: flatbread, fried dough, a rice roll and soy milk. Learning the names makes a menu less mysterious. It does not mean everyone eats the same breakfast, or that recipes are identical. Ingredients, fillings and shared cooking equipment still need a separate conversation if you have dietary requirements.
